name: Cargo Distribution (prototype)
summary: Unload a percentage of each vehicle's cargo at chosen line stops. Test saves only.
description: Version 0.2.0-prototype. Open a stop from the line manager; the stop window now has an Unload card at the bottom. Turn on custom unloading to unload a percentage of the cargo each vehicle carries on arrival, for all cargo or selected cargo, with optional per-cargo percentages. Vehicles do not pick up cargo at such a stop. Known limitation: if two vehicles on the same line unload at the same stop at the same time, both follow the most recent arrival. Prototype: use test saves. Author credit and licensing must be selected before publication.
